exposure: Abnormal middle cerebral artery (MCA) Doppler findings (MoM >1.5)
cohort: 100 antenatal women with risk factors for fetal anemia, such as Rh isoimmunization, hydrops fetalis, or fetomaternal hemorrhage.
finding: A statistically significant association was found between abnormal MCA Doppler findings and neonatal anemia, with MCA Doppler demonstrating high diagnostic accuracy for predicting neonatal anemia.
cross-section timing: Late third trimester (>=32 weeks gestation) for MCA Doppler; at birth for neonatal hemoglobin measurement.
gest_age: Exposure measured after 32 weeks gestation; neonatal anemia defined by values below 2 standard deviations for gestational age.
